votes.motion: Terminate the Land Development Agreement for the Jones House, 42 Main Street.

budget_items.topic: School construction project financing - planned bond issues
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Planned bond issues: $6.3M in October/November 2014 to retire the notes, a $6.6M issue in June 2015, and further $20M (January 2016) and $2M (January 2017) amounts.
budget_items.quote: current plan is for the town to issue $6.3m of bonds in october/november of this year.
